# Humans
Depending on who you ask, humans are either unremarkable or the universal standard to which everything else is compared due to just how numerous they are.
## Racial Features - They have no particular strengths or weaknesses. - Their fists deal [color=red]5[/color] blunt damage with unarmed attacks.
## Sol Common The standard language humans speak, known as Sol Common, is composed of a series of short gutteral grunts. It was designed to be simple and easy to learn, allowing most species to be able to produce the sounds required to speak it.
## Age and Names A human's lifespan is considered the standard across the galaxy, as the majority of species have little to no variation from this baseline. They reach adulthood at 18 years of age and are able to live up to 150. Human names are usually given to them by their parents at birth but it is not uncommon to see a human change their own name later in life.
